resolved_failures: Initial focused fixture failures included PostgreSQL recovery/unavailability and a test seed missing guard_revisions.search_text; corrected fixture and successful later runs retained.

An over-broad ingestion validation rejected an existing scheduler-generated envelope. Validation now enforces the new source contract without rewriting or rejecting legacy internal identity metadata; scheduler regression passes.
The broad suite approval setup saw PostgreSQL 57P03 and the dashboard child was temporarily unreachable. Both passed their targeted rerun.
The disconnection test required the explicit NOCHEH_WORKFLOW_FIXTURE=1 opt-in. Its isolated rerun passed.

A later final run did not start because fixture PostgreSQL was unhealthy, with backend exit code 2 and repeated recovery. Only this fixture was restarted; all six final tests and dump/restore/restart passed. Root cause of the transient fixture exits is unproven.
limits: Slack/Discord export parsers and source-specific polling/ACL mapping are separate adapter work.
The three skipped workflow/routing/native-UI checks require separate runtime fixtures.
No production-volume performance or live installation migration is claimed.
Full Node 24 candidate-image build remains an activation prerequisite; runtime database tests used verified Node 24 with the pinned dependency lock.
